name: Fürstenberg (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and blue with a broad yellow middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Fürstenberg (a white vase and a yellow lion on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Fürstenberg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Fürstenberg arms — vase and lion on blue
